s1.syndrome_frame: subacute onset of systemic and joint symptoms with morning stiffness and paresthesia
salient_findings: fever, weakness, headache, fatigue, and dry cough lasting for three weeks
joint symptoms, acute back pain, and paresthesia after vaccination
morning stiffness and knee pain, more severe in the mornings and improving throughout the day
small red node and mild joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint of left index finger
key_facts: 52-year-old woman with normal BMI (23.5)
history of controlled asthma (no medication needed)
routine use of rosuvastatin (20 mg) daily
experienced moderate severity symptoms in October 2020
symptoms lasted for three weeks, not requiring hospitalization
developed joint symptoms after vaccination
experienced morning stiffness and knee pain
symptoms eventually concentrated around the elbow
total leucocyte count: 6.62 cells/μl (normal range)
C-reactive protein (CRP): normal
rheumatoid factor (RF): negative
anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP) antibodies: normal range
SARS-CoV-2 PCR: initially positive, negative after 3 weeks
SARS-CoV-2 IgG: positive against Spike protein

shortlist.label: Seronegative Rheumatoid Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: negative rheumatoid factor and anti-CCP antibodies with joint symptoms and morning stiffness

shortlist.label: Psoriatic Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: joint symptoms, morning stiffness, and paresthesia, although no skin lesions mentioned

shortlist.label: Reactive Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: history of recent infection (SARS-CoV-2) and development of joint symptoms

shortlist.label: Vaccination-related Arthritis
shortlist.why_kept: onset of joint symptoms after vaccination

shortlist.label: Osteoarthritis
shortlist.why_kept: joint deformity at distal interphalangeal joint and morning stiffness

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including morning stiffness, joint pain, and joint deformity, are consistent with rheumatoid arthritis. The negative rheumatoid factor (RF) and anti-cyclic citrullinated peptide (anti-CCP) antibodies suggest seronegative rheumatoid arthritis.

rejected.label: Psoriatic Arthritis
rejected.why: There is no mention of psoriasis or skin symptoms

rejected.label: Reactive Arthritis
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms do not follow a typical reactive arthritis pattern, and there is no clear trigger

rejected.label: Vaccination-related Arthritis
rejected.why: While the patient developed joint symptoms after vaccination, the symptoms are more consistent with a chronic condition like seronegative rheumatoid arthritis

rejected.label: Osteoarthritis
rejected.why: The patient's age and symptoms are not typical for osteoarthritis, and the presence of morning stiffness and joint deformity suggest an inflammatory condition
